verdict.score_rationale: The board breathes and its staged flow is readable, but large dead frame areas, note-heavy regions, and several plain-box vocabulary substitutions leave it at the rubric’s “doesn’t finish” anchor.

sub_checks.name: frame_use
sub_checks.note: The five-stage sequence uses the upper middle coherently, but a vast empty top band and an especially large unused lower-right area make the content feel packed toward the left and center.

sub_checks.name: color
sub_checks.note: Teal reviewers, blue calibration memory, gray process/infrastructure elements, and yellow message-like notes are restrained and largely registry-consistent, though the repeated yellow prose cards visually outweigh the operational objects.

sub_checks.name: machinery_leakage
sub_checks.note: No crosshair junctions or orphaned badges are visible, but the very long dashed orange, red, blue, and gray return routes skim containers and frame space in a routing-mechanical rather than fully polished manner.

sub_checks.name: alignment_and_rhythm
sub_checks.note: The five reviewer agents form a strong regular register and the main stages align, but inconsistent panel densities, oversized prose notes, and generic boxes for event, monitoring, tools, and telemetry weaken hierarchy and operational-map vocabulary.
